review_status: UNREVIEWED - no qualified clinician or pharmacist has reviewed these rules. Every rule below is a transcription of a US FDA label sentence (see 'source.quote'), not clinical advice. Re-check against the current label before relying on it, and have a pharmacist review before use with real patients.
scope_note: Rules come from US FDA prescribing information via DailyMed/openFDA. Indian brands carry their own labels; an ingredient-level rule is shown to the patient as 'according to the US FDA label'. Use tools/verify_rule_sources.py to re-check every quote against the live label.

spacing_rules.plain: Calcium can bind levothyroxine in the gut and reduce how much is absorbed.

spacing_rules.plain: Calcium can stop ciprofloxacin from being absorbed properly. The label asks for ciprofloxacin to be taken 2 hours before, or 6 hours after, calcium.

source.title: Ciprofloxacin tablets - US FDA prescribing information
source.quote: Administer ciprofloxacin tablets at least 2 hours before or 6 hours after magnesium/aluminum antacids; polymeric phosphate binders (for example, sevelamer, lanthanum carbonate) or sucralfate; Videx

spacing_rules.plain: Iron can stop ciprofloxacin from being absorbed properly. The label asks for ciprofloxacin to be taken 2 hours before, or 6 hours after, iron.

source.title: Ciprofloxacin tablets - US FDA prescribing information
source.quote: Inform patients that antacids containing magnesium, or aluminum, as well as sucralfate, metal cations such as iron, and multivitamin preparations with zinc or didanosine should be taken at least two hours before or six hours after ciprofloxacin tablets administration.

alendronate_rule.plain: Alendronate is absorbed poorly if anything else is taken with it. Take it first, with plain water, and wait at least half an hour before other medicines.

source.title: Fosamax (alendronate sodium) tablets - US FDA prescribing information
source.quote: Therefore, instruct patients to wait at least one-half hour after taking FOSAMAX before taking any other oral medications.

interval_unspecified_rules.plain: Acid-reducing medicines can reduce how much levothyroxine is absorbed. The label does not give a spacing time for these, so ask your pharmacist or doctor.

source.title: Levothyroxine sodium tablets - US FDA prescribing information
source.quote: Sucralfate, antacids and proton pump inhibitors may cause hypochlorhydria, affect intragastric pH, and reduce levothyroxine absorption.

interval_unspecified_rules.plain: Calcium can reduce how much doxycycline is absorbed. The label does not give a spacing time, so ask your pharmacist or doctor how far apart to take them.

source.quote: If a dose is missed, it should be taken anytime but not later than 6 hours prior to the next scheduled dose.

source.title: Metformin hydrochloride tablets - US FDA patient information

alendronate.applies_to_note: Applies to the once-weekly regimen described in the label.

source.title: Fosamax (alendronate sodium) tablets - US FDA prescribing information
source.quote: If patients miss a dose of once weekly FOSAMAX, instruct patients to take one dose on the morning after they remember.

source.title: Telmisartan tablets - US FDA patient information
source.quote: If it is close to your next dose, do not take the missed dose.

source.title: Amlodipine besylate tablets - US FDA patient information
source.quote: If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember.

high_risk.note: For these medicines SmartPoli never calculates or suggests a catch-up time. It shows the label sentence where one exists and tells the patient to contact their prescriber or pharmacist. A missed or doubled dose can have serious consequences.

source.title: Warfarin sodium tablets - US FDA medication guide
source.quote: If you miss a dose of warfarin sodium tablets, call your healthcare provider.
